title: Scope report access to the requested account
description: Reports are selected by account ID, but the old endpoint checked only a global analyst role. An analyst for account A could request account B. Resolve the account first and check the caller's account membership before loading a report. Existing admins must retain cross-account access. Missing accounts and denied accounts must both return the same public response so callers cannot probe account IDs.

commits.title: Check account membership before report lookup
commits.body: Keep the public denial response unchanged.

issues.title: Analyst role crosses account boundary
issues.body: Authorization must bind the actor to the requested account.
